notes: Native universal macOS SwiftUI app for Apple silicon and Intel, built with the macOS 27 SDK. Dedicated desktop workspace with three-column Chats, native Bots and Jobs tables, Jobs inspector, standard Settings window and keyboard commands. Includes compact agent handoffs, reasoning and tools disclosures, secure input, guarded chat deletion and server-backed archive/restore. Internal build signed with Apple Development, published without notarization at the owner’s request; Gatekeeper does not accept this build automatically. Notarization remains tracked in GitHub issue #1.
